sample_chunks.text: Where any goods sold to a consumer suffer from a manufacturing defect or fail to perform as specified in the product description, the seller or manufacturer shall be liable to replace the defective item without extra charge or issue a full monetary refund within fourteen calendar days of complaint submission.
sample_chunks.issue: Defective product replacement and full refund rights
sample_chunks.section_title: Right to Replacement or Refund for Defective Goods
sample_chunks.plain_explanation: If you buy a product that is defective or doesn't work as advertised, the seller must replace it for free or give you a full refund within 14 days.
sample_chunks.applicability: Applies to all retail and e-commerce purchases of physical goods.

sample_chunks.text: Any service provider or retailer publishing advertisements containing false representations regarding price, origin, quality, or features of products commits an unfair trade practice. Affected consumers are entitled to compensation and statutory damages up to twice the purchase price.
sample_chunks.issue: Misleading advertising and deceptive price claims
sample_chunks.section_title: Prohibition of Unfair Trade Practices and Misleading Ads
sample_chunks.plain_explanation: Sellers cannot use false advertisements or fake discounts. If they trick you with false claims, you can demand compensation.
sample_chunks.applicability: Applies to advertisements, promotional offers, and marketing across print, digital, and broadcast media.

sample_chunks.text: E-commerce platforms that fail to deliver ordered goods within the confirmed delivery timeline without valid force majeure reasons shall automatically refund the full transaction amount along with a default compensation penalty of 5 percent per week of delay.
sample_chunks.issue: Deficiency of service in e-commerce logistics and non-delivery
sample_chunks.section_title: Duties of Digital Platforms regarding Delivery Timelines
sample_chunks.plain_explanation: Online stores must deliver your order on time. If they fail without a valid reason, you get a full refund plus a delay penalty.
sample_chunks.applicability: Applies to online shopping platforms and third-party sellers.

sample_chunks.text: Manufacturers shall not void a consumer product warranty solely because the consumer engaged an independent technician for routine maintenance, provided the maintenance did not directly cause the alleged defect.
sample_chunks.issue: Warranty void claims based on unauthorized third-party repairs
sample_chunks.section_title: Right to Repair and Warranty Protections
sample_chunks.plain_explanation: Companies cannot cancel your warranty just because an independent repair shop did basic maintenance on your device.
sample_chunks.applicability: Applies to electronic items, appliances, and motor vehicles.

sample_chunks.text: No service provider shall levy recurring charges, hidden fees, or automatic subscription renewals without explicit prior affirmative opt-in consent from the account holder.
sample_chunks.issue: Hidden charges and un-consented subscription billing
sample_chunks.section_title: Mandatory Prior Opt-in for Recurring Commercial Fees
sample_chunks.plain_explanation: Companies cannot add hidden fees or auto-renew subscriptions without your clear prior permission.
sample_chunks.applicability: Applies to telecom, software subscriptions, banking, and streaming services.

sample_chunks.text: Any vendor selling packaged food items beyond their specified expiry date or containing unapproved chemical contaminants shall refund the consumer and reimburse medical expenses incurred as a direct consequence.
sample_chunks.issue: Adulterated or substandard food items purchased at retail
sample_chunks.act: Dummy Food Safety and Standards Regulation, 2024
sample_chunks.section_title: Liability for Sale of Contaminated or Expired Foodstuffs
sample_chunks.plain_explanation: If a shop sells expired or contaminated food that makes you sick, they must refund you and pay your medical expenses.
sample_chunks.applicability: Applies to supermarkets, restaurants, and food delivery services.
